terms.meta_description: Terms and conditions governing the use of our community timebanking platform.
terms.heading: Terms of Service
terms.subtitle: The rules and guidelines for using our platform
terms.welcome_body_1: By accessing or using our platform, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. Please read them carefully before participating in our community.
terms.welcome_body_2_before: These terms establish a framework for
terms.welcome_body_2_after: between community members. Our goal is to create a trusted environment where everyone's time is valued equally.
terms.section1_intro_before: Our platform operates on a simple but powerful principle:
terms.credits_no_monetary_value: Time Credits have no monetary value and cannot be exchanged for cash. They exist solely to facilitate community exchanges.
terms.credit_rule_1: One hour of service provided equals one Time Credit earned
terms.credit_rule_2: Credits can be used to receive services from other members
terms.credit_rule_3: The type of service does not affect the credit value
terms.credit_rule_4: Credits are tracked automatically through the platform
terms.section2_intro: When you create an account, you agree to:
terms.account_accurate_desc: Your profile must reflect your true identity and skills
terms.account_security_desc: Keep your login credentials confidential and secure
terms.account_one_account_desc: Each person may only maintain one active account
terms.account_current_desc: Update your profile when your skills or availability change
terms.account_reachable_desc: Respond to messages and requests in a timely manner
terms.guideline_respect_desc: Be kind and courteous in all interactions
terms.guideline_honour_desc: If you agree to an exchange, follow through
terms.guideline_communicate_desc: Keep other members informed about your availability
terms.guideline_inclusive_desc: Welcome members of all backgrounds and abilities
terms.guideline_feedback_desc: Help the community by providing fair reviews
terms.section4_intro: The following activities are strictly prohibited and may result in account termination:
terms.section5_intro: Your safety is important. We recommend following these guidelines:
terms.safety_first_meetings_desc: Meet in public places for initial exchanges
terms.safety_verify_desc: Confirm the member's profile before meeting
terms.safety_instincts_desc: If something feels wrong, do not proceed
terms.safety_report_desc: Let us know about any suspicious behaviour
terms.section6_intro: {{name}} provides a platform for community members to connect and exchange services. However:
terms.liability_no_guarantee: We do not guarantee the quality or safety of any services exchanged
terms.liability_no_disputes: We are not responsible for disputes between members
terms.liability_own_risk: Members exchange services at their own risk
terms.liability_insurance: We recommend obtaining appropriate insurance for professional services
terms.liability_hold_harmless: By using the platform, you agree to hold {{name}} harmless from any claims arising from your participation in service exchanges.
terms.section7_intro: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate accounts that violate these terms. Reasons for termination include:
terms.termination_self_close: You may also close your account at any time through your account settings.
terms.section8_intro: We may update these terms from time to time to reflect changes in our practices or for legal reasons. When we make significant changes:
terms.changes_notify: We will notify you via email or platform notification
terms.changes_date_shown: The updated date will be shown at the top of this page
terms.changes_continued_use: Continued use of the platform constitutes acceptance of the new terms
terms.cta_body: If you have any questions about these Terms of Service or need clarification on any points, our team is here to help.

privacy.data_safeguarding_collected: Community, member, controlled scheme, purpose and scope, confirmed or revoked decision, authorised decision-maker, timestamps, controlled reason code and policy version. We do not ask for or store the certificate, reference number, dates, result, criminal-record details, free-text notes or identity documents.
privacy.data_safeguarding_why: To enforce a member's private contact preference and provide an auditable correction and review process.
privacy.safeguarding_data_body: Where a community lawfully requires an Enhanced DBS confirmation for safeguarded member contact, the community completes its own checks outside Project NEXUS. An authorised broker records only the resulting community decision. This is not a claim that a member is safe, has no criminal record or is cleared for every role.
privacy.safeguarding_data_access: Access is limited to authorised brokers and administrators in the member's community and is not shown on public profiles, badges, search results or ordinary analytics.
privacy.safeguarding_data_retention: The Community Operator must publish and apply a documented retention schedule and remove metadata when it is no longer necessary, subject to any properly documented legal obligation.
privacy.safeguarding_data_correction: Members can view their private status, request a broker review without sending evidence, and ask the Community Operator to correct or challenge an inaccurate decision.
privacy.meta_description: How we collect, use, and protect your personal data on our community platform.
privacy.heading: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: How we collect, use, and protect your personal information
privacy.commitment_body_1: {{name}} is committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring your personal data is handled responsibly. This policy explains what information we collect, why we collect it, and how you can manage your data.
privacy.commitment_body_2_after: You have the right to understand and manage how your information is used.
privacy.data_collection_intro: We collect only the information necessary to provide and improve our services:
privacy.data_account_why: Required to create and manage your account
privacy.data_profile_why: Helps connect you with community members
privacy.data_device_collected: Browser type, IP address, device type
privacy.data_analytics_collected: Pages visited, features used, session duration
privacy.data_usage_intro: Your data is used exclusively for the following purposes:
privacy.usage_delivery_desc: Facilitating time exchanges and community connections
privacy.usage_communication_desc: Sending important updates, notifications, and messages from other members
privacy.usage_security_desc: Protecting your account and preventing fraud or abuse
privacy.usage_improvement_desc: Analysing usage patterns to enhance platform features
privacy.no_sell_data: We do not sell your personal data to third parties. Your information is never shared with advertisers or data brokers.
privacy.visibility_body_1: Your profile is visible to other verified members of the timebank community. This visibility is essential for facilitating exchanges and building trust within the community.
privacy.visibility_body_2_before: You can control what information appears on your profile through your
privacy.visibility_body_2_after: Some information, like your name and general location, is required for meaningful community participation.
privacy.protection_intro: We implement robust security measures to safeguard your information:
privacy.protect_encryption_desc: All data encrypted in transit (HTTPS) and at rest
privacy.protect_access_desc: Strict internal policies limit data access
privacy.rights_intro: Under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), you have full control over your personal data. Here are your rights:
privacy.right_access_desc: Request a copy of all personal data we hold about you. We will respond within 30 days.
privacy.right_rectification_desc: Correct any inaccurate or incomplete personal information we hold about you.
privacy.right_erasure_desc: Request deletion of your account and all associated personal data.
privacy.right_portability_desc: Export your data in a structured, machine-readable format (JSON or CSV).
privacy.right_restrict_desc: Request that we limit how we process your data while a concern is being resolved.
privacy.right_withdraw_desc: Withdraw consent for optional data processing at any time without affecting prior processing.
privacy.rights_contact: To exercise any of these rights, please contact us through our contact page. We will respond to all requests within 30 days.
privacy.cookies_intro: We use cookies to enhance your experience on our platform:
privacy.cookie_essential_desc: Required for login, security, and basic platform functionality. Cannot be disabled.
privacy.cookie_preference_desc: Remember your settings such as theme preference, language, and display options.
privacy.cookie_analytics_desc: Help us understand how people use the platform so we can improve features. All data is anonymised.
privacy.cookies_no_ads_after: use advertising cookies or share data with ad networks. You can manage cookie preferences in your browser settings. For more details, see our
privacy.retention_intro: We retain your data only as long as necessary:
privacy.retention_active_desc: Data is kept while your account remains active
privacy.retention_deleted_desc: Personal data is removed within 30 days of account deletion
privacy.retention_transactions_desc: May be retained for up to 7 years for legal and audit purposes
privacy.retention_logs_desc: IP addresses and access logs retained for 12 months
privacy.cta_body: We are here to help. If you have any questions about this policy or want to exercise your data rights, please do not hesitate to reach out.

cookies.meta_description: Information about how we use cookies to improve your experience on our platform.
cookies.heading: Cookie Policy
cookies.subtitle: How we use cookies and similar technologies on our platform
cookies.what_are_body_1: Cookies are small text files that are placed on your device when you visit a website. They are widely used to make websites work more efficiently and to provide information to the owners of the site.
cookies.what_are_body_2: {{name}} uses cookies and similar technologies to ensure you get the best experience on our platform. This policy explains which cookies we use, why we use them, and how you can control them.
cookies.cat_essential_desc: These cookies are strictly necessary for the platform to function. They enable core functionality such as authentication, security, and session management. Without these cookies, the platform cannot operate properly.
cookies.cat_essential_ex4: Load balancing and anonymous fault reports
cookies.cat_analytics_desc: These cookies help us understand how visitors interact with the platform by collecting and reporting information anonymously. This helps us improve the platform experience for everyone.
cookies.cat_preference_desc: These cookies remember your preferences and settings to provide a more personalised experience. They allow the platform to remember choices you make such as theme, language, and display options.
cookies.no_marketing: We do not use marketing or advertising cookies. We never share your data with advertisers or ad networks.
cookies.cookie_session_purpose: Maintains your authenticated session across page loads
cookies.cookie_csrf_purpose: Protects against cross-site request forgery attacks
cookies.cookie_token_purpose: JWT authentication token for API requests
cookies.cookie_refresh_purpose: Refresh token for seamless session renewal
cookies.cookie_locale_purpose: Stores language and regional format preference
cookies.cookie_consent_purpose: Stores your cookie consent preferences (categories accepted)
cookies.cookie_sentry_purpose: Anonymous fault reports. Always sent, even if you decline analytics cookies, so we can fix what breaks. Speed measurements and session replay are only sent if you accept analytics cookies.
cookies.third_party_intro: In some cases, we use third-party services that may set their own cookies. These services include:
cookies.third_party_sentry_desc: Anonymous fault reporting. Always active, even if you decline analytics cookies. A report contains no name, no account number and no web address details. Speed measurements and session replay are only active if you accept analytics cookies.
cookies.third_party_pusher_desc: For real-time notifications and messaging functionality
cookies.third_party_compliance: We carefully select our third-party partners and ensure they comply with applicable data protection regulations. Third-party cookies are governed by the respective third party's privacy policy.
cookies.manage_intro: You can control and manage cookies in several ways. Please note that removing or blocking cookies may impact your user experience and some functionality may no longer be available.
cookies.manage_warning: Disabling essential cookies will prevent you from logging in and using core platform features. We recommend keeping essential cookies enabled.
cookies.browser_settings_intro: Most web browsers allow you to manage cookies through their settings. Here is where to find cookie settings in popular browsers:
cookies.browser_chrome_path: Settings > Privacy and security > Cookies and other site data
cookies.browser_firefox_path: Settings > Privacy & Security > Cookies and Site Data
cookies.browser_edge_path: Settings > Cookies and site permissions > Cookies and site data
cookies.cta_body: If you have any questions about our use of cookies or this policy, please do not hesitate to contact us.

community_guidelines.heading: Community Guidelines
community_guidelines.subtitle: How we expect everyone in {{communityName}} to treat each other. Short, plain-English, and applies to every exchange, message, post, and event.

kind.title: 1. Be kind and respectful
kind.body: Treat other members the way you would treat a neighbour. Disagreement is fine; contempt, name-calling, mockery, and personal attacks are not.

items.0: No harassment, bullying, stalking, or intimidation.
items.1: No hate speech, slurs, or content that demeans people because of who they are, including race, ethnicity, nationality, religion, gender, sexuality, disability, age, or background.
items.2: No threats of violence, real or implied.

honest.title: 2. Be honest
honest.body: Trust is what makes a timebank work. Misrepresenting yourself or what you're offering damages the whole community.

items.0: Use your real name and a real photo on your profile.
items.1: Describe skills, listings, and requests accurately. Don't exaggerate what you can do or how long something takes.
items.2: Log hours honestly. Don't claim time you didn't give.

relevant.title: 3. Keep it relevant
relevant.body: This is a space for community exchange, not a marketplace, billboard, or political platform.

items.0: No spam, repeated promotion, or off-topic blasts.
items.1: No commercial selling, recruiting, or fundraising outside the features designed for it, such as jobs, organisations, or marketplace where enabled.
items.2: No campaign material, partisan organising, or content designed to inflame political conflict. Civic engagement is welcome; partisan combat is not.

privacy.title: 4. Protect privacy
privacy.body: What members share inside the community stays inside the community.

items.0: Don't share another member's personal information, such as address, phone, photos, health details, or family situation, without their clear permission.
items.1: Don't post screenshots of private messages.
items.2: Don't take photos at community events without asking the people in them.
items.3: Use the platform's messaging for exchange-related communication; don't push people onto outside channels before they're comfortable.

in_person.title: 5. Look after each other in person
in_person.body: Exchanges often involve meeting in person, sometimes in someone's home. Use ordinary common sense.

items.0: Read the member's profile and reviews before a first exchange.
items.1: Meet in a public place for the first exchange when you can.
items.2: Tell someone you trust where you're going and when you expect to be back.
items.3: Stop the exchange and leave if something feels wrong. You don't owe anyone an explanation in the moment.
items.4: If someone is unsafe, themselves or with others, see Trust & Safety for how to report. In an emergency, contact local emergency services first.

report.title: 6. Report concerns
report.body_before: If you see something that breaks these guidelines, or that worries you, tell us. You can:

items.0: Use the report button on any profile, listing, message, post, or event.
items.1: Email the community team via the Contact page.
items.2: For safeguarding concerns, such as a child or vulnerable adult at risk, see the Trust & Safety page for the dedicated reporting route.

report.body_after: Reports are reviewed by moderators and treated confidentially. We don't share your identity with the person you reported unless you've asked us to or the law requires it.

enforcement.title: 7. What happens when guidelines are broken
enforcement.body_before: Most issues are small misunderstandings and a quiet word fixes them. For clearer breaches we use proportionate steps:

items.0: A reminder, for first-time, minor issues.
items.1: Removal of content, such as a post, listing, or message taken down.
items.2: A warning, recorded on your account.
items.3: Temporary suspension, for repeated or serious issues.
items.4: Permanent removal, for harassment, safeguarding breaches, fraud, threats, hate speech, or repeated suspensions.

enforcement.body_serious: Serious matters, including abuse, threats, fraud, or exploitation, may be reported to appropriate law enforcement or a competent authority regardless of the platform action.
enforcement.body_appeal: If you think a decision was wrong, you can appeal via the Contact page. We'll review it with a moderator who wasn't involved in the original decision.

changes.title: Changes to these guidelines
changes.body: We may update these guidelines as the community grows. Material changes will be announced in the platform and recorded in the legal version history.

acceptable_use.heading: Acceptable Use Policy
acceptable_use.subtitle: The specific behaviours that are not allowed on {{platformName}}. This sits alongside the Terms of Service and the Community Guidelines and applies to every account.

scope.title: 1. Scope
scope.body: This policy applies to anyone using {{platformName}}: members, organisations, visitors, API users, and integrators. It applies to all activity on the platform, including profiles, listings, messages, events, posts, polls, jobs, files, and outbound communications sent through the platform.

illegal.title: 2. No illegal activity
illegal.body: You must not use the platform to:

items.0: Carry out, plan, or facilitate anything illegal where you, the other person, or the activity is located.
items.1: Offer or solicit services that require professional licensing or regulation you don't hold, such as unlicensed medical, legal, financial, electrical, gas, or childcare work.
items.2: Trade in regulated or restricted goods, including alcohol, tobacco, prescription medicines, firearms, controlled drugs, or similar restricted items.
items.3: Launder money or evade tax obligations.

items.0: Don't impersonate another person, organisation, or official body.
items.1: Don't create fake accounts, sock-puppets, or duplicate accounts to manipulate ratings, reviews, polls, or matching.
items.2: Don't misrepresent your identity, credentials, qualifications, or vetting status.
items.3: Don't manipulate time-credit balances through fake exchanges, collusion, or staged transactions.

items.0: No harassment, bullying, stalking, doxxing, or coordinated targeting.
items.1: No hate speech, slurs, or content that demeans people on the basis of protected characteristics.
items.2: No threats, incitement, or glorification of violence.
items.3: No content that sexualises children, in any form.
items.4: No non-consensual sexual content, intimate-image abuse, or content posted to shame or extort.
items.5: No promotion of self-harm or suicide. If you or someone you know is in crisis, contact local emergency services or a recognised helpline.

items.0: Sexually explicit content, gratuitous violence, or shock content.
items.1: Content that infringes someone else's copyright, trademark, or other intellectual property.
items.2: Confidential information you're not entitled to share, such as employer secrets or protected health information.
items.3: Personal data about others posted without their consent.

misuse.title: 6. No spam, abuse, or platform misuse

items.0: No unsolicited bulk messaging, repeated identical posts, or promotional blasts.
items.1: No scraping, mass-downloading, or automated harvesting of profiles, listings, or other data, except via documented APIs and within their rate limits.
items.2: No artificial inflation of engagement, including fake likes, reviews, endorsements, matches, badges, or leaderboard positions.
items.3: No referral, MLM, pyramid, or get-paid-to-click schemes.
items.4: No using the platform primarily to drive traffic to an external site or service unrelated to community exchange.

items.0: No probing, scanning, or testing for vulnerabilities without prior written permission. Coordinated disclosure is welcomed via the Contact page.
items.1: No malware, viruses, worms, or other malicious code.
items.2: No attempts to bypass authentication, rate limits, paywalls, feature gates, or moderation tools.
items.3: No denial-of-service attempts or activity that materially degrades service for others.
items.4: No reverse engineering, decompiling, or extracting source code, except where the AGPL-3.0 licence expressly permits it.

items.0: Don't share your account credentials. You're responsible for activity under your account.
items.1: Notify us promptly if you believe your account has been compromised.
items.2: Don't transfer or sell your account to anyone else.
items.3: Use the platform's tools to delete or export your data; don't try to extract it through automation.

enforcement.title: 9. Enforcement
enforcement.body: Breaches may result in content removal, warnings, temporary suspension, or permanent removal of access, proportionate to severity and history. Serious breaches may be reported to appropriate law enforcement, the relevant data protection regulator, or other competent authorities, and we may be legally obliged to do so.
enforcement.appeal: You can appeal an enforcement decision via the Contact page. Appeals are reviewed by someone not involved in the original decision.

reporting.title: 10. Reporting violations
reporting.body: If you spot something that breaches this policy, use the in-product report tool on the relevant profile, listing, message, post, or event, or email the team via the Contact page. For safeguarding concerns about a child or vulnerable adult, follow the dedicated route on the Trust & Safety page.

changes.title: 11. Changes
changes.body: We may update this policy as the platform and the regulatory environment evolve. Material changes will be announced and recorded in the legal version history.

trust_safety.title: Trust & Safety
trust_safety.description: How exchanges work on {{name}}, what we do to keep the community safe, what we don’t do, and how to report a concern. Plain-English trust and safeguarding.

trust_safety.vetting_attestation_body: Where a community policy requires vetted contact, the community carries out its lawful checking outside Project NEXUS. An authorised broker can record a private, metadata-only community confirmation for the specific contact policy. Project NEXUS does not ask for or retain DBS, Garda Vetting, AccessNI, PVG or equivalent certificates, reference numbers, results or criminal-record details. A confirmation does not mean a person is universally safe or cleared for every role.
trust_safety.what_we_dont_vetting_item: We do not independently inspect or store criminal-record certificates, certify a member for a profession, or turn a contact-policy confirmation into universal role clearance.
trust_safety.precautions_vetting_item: For activities involving children or vulnerable adults, contact your community coordinator about the rules that apply. Do not ask another member to send a DBS, Garda Vetting, AccessNI, PVG or equivalent certificate through Project NEXUS.
trust_safety.meta_description: How exchanges work on {{name}}, what we do to keep the community safe, what we don’t do, and how to report a concern. Plain-English trust and safeguarding.
trust_safety.heading: Trust & Safety
trust_safety.subtitle: {{name}} connects neighbours so they can share skills using time credits. This page explains how that works in practice — what the platform does, what it doesn’t, and how you can stay safe.
trust_safety.safeguarding_body: If you’re worried about a member, an exchange, or something you’ve seen on the platform, please tell us. We respond to safeguarding reports within one working day.
trust_safety.safeguarding_step_1: Use the Report button on the relevant listing, message, or profile.
trust_safety.safeguarding_step_2: Or email us via the Contact page — mark the subject as “Safeguarding”.
trust_safety.safeguarding_step_3: If anyone is in immediate danger, contact local emergency services first.
trust_safety.how_exchanges_intro: Every exchange follows the same simple flow. There is no money involved — just time credits.

how_exchanges_steps.0: Find a member offering what you need, or post a request describing what you’re looking for.
how_exchanges_steps.1: Message them through the platform to agree the details — time, place, and what’s involved.
how_exchanges_steps.2: Complete the exchange. You only meet in person if you both want to.
how_exchanges_steps.3: Log the hours. Both members confirm — that’s the receipt.
how_exchanges_steps.4: Time credits transfer automatically. One hour of help = one time credit, no matter what skill was shared.

what_we_do_items.0: Verifies every member’s email address at registration; offers optional photo-ID verification with a Verified Member badge for those who want extra trust signals.
what_we_do_items.1: Shows reviews and ratings on member profiles so the community can see who’s been a reliable exchange partner.
what_we_do_items.2: Asks every member to accept our Community Guidelines and Acceptable Use Policy at signup, and to keep to them while they’re here.
what_we_do_items.3: Gives every listing, message, and profile a Report button that goes straight to coordinators.
what_we_do_items.4: Has human coordinators who can mediate, support, and step in when something goes wrong.
what_we_do_items.5: Connects with other timebanks across regions through federation, so reputation can travel with you.

trust_safety.what_we_dont_intro: Timebanking is built on neighbours helping neighbours, not on us standing between you. That’s a feature, not a bug — but it does mean we need to be clear about our limits.

what_we_dont_items.0: We don’t vet, train, or certify members for specific services. We’re not a recruitment agency.
what_we_dont_items.1: We don’t provide insurance coverage for the work members do for each other.
what_we_dont_items.2: We don’t supervise exchanges or act as anyone’s employer or service provider.
what_we_dont_items.3: We don’t guarantee any specific outcome, level of skill, or punctuality. Reviews are how the community keeps itself accountable.

trust_safety.precautions_title: Sensible precautions for a first exchange
trust_safety.precautions_intro: You’d apply the same common sense here as you would meeting anyone new through a community group.

precautions_items.0: Meet in a public place the first time, or bring a friend if you’re inviting someone to your home.
precautions_items.1: Read the other member’s reviews and check how long they’ve been on the platform.
precautions_items.2: For services involving children, vulnerable adults, or work inside your home, ask about any background checks or vetting required in your jurisdiction before agreeing.
precautions_items.3: Trust your instincts. You can say no, end an exchange, or report a concern at any time.

trust_safety.vetting_body: Some exchanges, for example childcare, elderly care, or support for vulnerable adults, may legally require a background check or vetting under local law. Members offering these kinds of services are responsible for holding current, valid vetting where their jurisdiction requires it, and you're entitled to ask to see it before you agree to an exchange. The platform doesn't hold vetting on members' behalf and doesn't verify it.

insurance_items.0: {{name}} does not provide insurance for exchanges between members. The platform is a connection service — it does not insure, indemnify, or underwrite the work members do for each other.
insurance_items.1: Members are NOT covered by any platform insurance for the work they do for each other. Exchanges are entirely between members and at members’ own risk. See our Terms of Service for the full liability and indemnity position.
insurance_items.2: If you offer professional services (plumbing, electrical, healthcare, legal, financial advice), you’re responsible for your own professional indemnity insurance and any regulatory obligations that apply.
insurance_items.3: Time credits have no monetary value. They can’t be exchanged for cash, sold, or used outside the timebanking community.

trust_safety.disputes_intro: Most disagreements can be sorted out between members. If they can’t, we’ll help.

disputes_steps.0: Try first to resolve it directly through messages — most misunderstandings are just that.
disputes_steps.1: If that doesn’t work, contact a coordinator via the Contact page. Coordinators can mediate.
disputes_steps.2: If a member breaches our Community Guidelines, we take action — warnings, mediation, suspension, or removal, depending on severity.
disputes_steps.3: Time-credit disputes (hours logged in error, etc.) are reviewed by an admin who can adjust balances on either side.

responsibilities_items.0: Treat other members with respect (Community Guidelines).
responsibilities_items.1: Be honest about your skills, qualifications, and limitations.
responsibilities_items.2: Show up when you commit, or cancel with reasonable notice.
responsibilities_items.3: Log hours fairly — for the time actually given.
responsibilities_items.4: Use the platform only for community time exchanges, not paid work, sales solicitation, or anything illegal (Acceptable Use Policy).

rights_items.0: Leave at any time and request your data be deleted (GDPR).
rights_items.1: Block other members so they can’t contact you.
rights_items.2: Make your profile invisible to search or browsing.
rights_items.3: Opt out of all optional cookies, analytics, and email notifications.

trust_safety.contact_cta_title: Have a question we haven’t answered?
trust_safety.contact_cta_body: Get in touch and a coordinator will get back to you. Most messages are answered within one working day.
